task_request:
I am a graduate researcher, and I need to create a conference poster for presenting my work on molecular property prediction using graph neural networks. Please create an A0 academic poster on "Graph Neural Network-Based Molecular Property Prediction". Generate 3 scientific figures: gnn_architecture.png showing the GNN architecture diagram, molecular_graph.png showing molecule-to-graph representation, and performance.png showing a performance comparison chart.

Build a 3-column poster, output as poster.pdf, with blue-green academic theme, including sections: Abstract, Introduction, Method with architecture figure, Molecular Representation, Experimental Results with performance figure, Conclusions, and References with 3-5 citations.

nodes.objective: Plan an A0 three-column blue-green academic poster titled Graph Neural Network-Based Molecular Property Prediction, with the requested sections, 3-5 references, a clear reading order, visual hierarchy, and precise specifications for three scientific figures.
Generate gnn_architecture.png as a clean scientific architecture diagram showing molecular graph input, message passing, pooling, and property prediction, with large readable labels.
Generate molecular_graph.png showing a molecule-to-graph representation with atoms as nodes and bonds as edges, using a publication-ready scientific style.
Generate performance.png as a legible comparison chart with coherent hypothetical-but-clearly-presented model labels and metrics suitable for the Experimental Results section.

Build and compile poster.pdf as an A0 three-column blue-green academic poster containing Abstract, Introduction, Method with architecture figure, Molecular Representation, Experimental Results with performance figure, Conclusions, and 3-5 references. Keep text readable at poster scale and eliminate overflow.
Inspect the compiled poster at full page and zoomed views, check A0 layout, columns, section coverage, figures, citations, margins, overflow, and readability, then report without modifying outputs.
